title: REQ · Cleanup untracks dependency paths with git rm --cached and keeps them on disk
summary: untrackNodeModules removes node_modules paths from the index only
description: Context: 15,329 dependency files are tracked. Desired behavior: a cleanup lists tracked files via an injected git runner, filters them, and runs git rm -r --cached for the matching top-level node_modules directories, never deleting from disk. Why: stops vendored files showing as tracked changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given tracked node_modules paths, when cleanup runs, then git is called with rm -r --cached --ignore-unmatch -- and the node_modules roots
Given no tracked node_modules paths, when cleanup runs, then git rm is not called
Given any call, then no --force or filesystem-deleting argument is passed
technical_constraints: Git args passed as an array, no shell string
definition_of_done: Cleanup exported and unit tested with a fake runner
non_functional: Batch roots, not one call per file, so it stays fast with 15,000 files
